Permits for Work within the County Right-of-Way
In accordance with New York State Highway Law Section 136, a permit must be obtained from the County for any work within the County Right-of-Way. Violating this section of New York State Highway Law may result in a fine of up to $1,000 for each day of violation.

Road Closures
May 5, 2026
To: The Town Clerk of the Town of HALFMOON
This is to certify that the undersigned, Commissioner of Public Works of the County of Saratoga, is closing a section of highway known as COONS CROSSING ROAD where it crosses the Anthony Kill, between the Zim Smith Trail Crossing / Ushers Road and NYS Rt 67. Access to the Zim Smith Trail and Park will still be permitted. The bridge will be closed beginning Monday, May 18th, 2026, until approximately Friday, August 28th, 2026. The road is being closed for a bridge replacement.
Chad M. Cooke, P.E.
County Commissioner of Public Work
